responsibility: This file defines the H8/300 backend’s RTL operand and operator predicates used by instruction patterns to classify valid sources, destinations, addressing modes, calls, shifts, bit operands, constants, and specialized instruction families. It encodes target-dependent acceptance rules such as H8SX memory tolerance, nibble-immediate recognition, bit-memory legality, ldm/stm parallel forms, and stack-pointer exclusions, forming the semantic front end that lets .md patterns describe H8 instructions precisely.
